designationHistory.name: Waubay Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Waubay Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7245 on December 10, 1935, as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Waubay National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7245, Dec. 10, 1935, Establishing Waubay Migratory Waterfowl Refuge, South Dakota

review.note: Year confirmed; exact date and EO added.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Waubay National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1935 as a “refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife.” During the 1930s, waterfowl populations dropped from an estimated 100 million (1930) to 20 million in 1934.
